data_fields.name: retreat_floor_fraction
data_fields.donor_constant: members < (attackSize + 1) / 2 (ceil of half the launch size)

data_fields.name: attack_probability_per_update
data_fields.donor_constant: maximum over triggers, each in 0..1 (second roll saturates above 0.1)

best_idea: One exclusive per-group order slot (hold or disengage) that the AI reads on every move, plus an automatic pull-out when the group falls below half its launch size.
decision_why: The exclusive order slot, the chase and follow switches and the retreat threshold fit the many-on-one rulings as engine state; the donor FLEE name is wrong (it only stops chasing) and its update loop returns early (village_control.cpp:437), so take the shape, not the code.
acceptance: In a 3-vs-1 server test, after hold is set the two followers issue no move toward the leader while more than one tile away and attack only adjacent enemies; when one of three attackers is left, the retreat order is set once and the remaining attacker stops chasing in the same tick.
